rules.name: Dynamic Imbalance Surge
rules.description: Multiply fare by surge ratio when surge > 1.10

rules.name: Severe Weather Supply Incentive
rules.description: When weather severity >= 1.0, add $3.50 driver hazard stipend

rules.name: Airport Facility Surcharge
rules.description: Airport pickup or dropoff includes fixed $5.00 surcharge

rules.name: Subprime Risk Premium
rules.description: Subprime applicants require +4.25% risk offset spread

rules.name: Super Prime Preferred Rate
rules.description: Super prime tier receives 0.75% rate discount

rules.name: High LTV Collateral Spread
rules.description: If LTV ratio exceeds 90%, add 0.50% risk margin

rules.name: High Load Factor Surge
rules.description: If cabin load exceeds 85%, add 30% yield uplift

rules.name: Departure Proximity Premium
rules.description: If departure is within 3 days, add $45 express booking fee

rules.name: High Sellout Velocity
rules.description: When auditorium is > 85% full, add $3.00 peak rush surcharge

rules.name: Early Matinee Incentive
rules.description: Matinee showtimes receive 20% discount

rules.name: Low Stock Scarcity Premium
rules.description: If stock units <= 10 and velocity >= 2.0, increase price by 8%

rules.name: High Value Cart Incentive
rules.description: If current cart exceeds $100, provide $10 discount
